name: Non-Free Simple Uniform-OM Tope Graph
statement: The class is the tope set of a non-free simple uniform oriented matroid; equivalently, its graph is an irredundantly embedded antipodal partial cube whose every proper convex antipodal subgraph is a hypercube.
hypotheses: At least three concepts; finite active-coordinate binary class.
comments: The oriented-matroid rank equals the VC dimension. Non-free excludes the hypercube case.
